title: Wood for the long winter
The fire on the pass
summary: The brothers of {settlement} burn their fire day and night for whoever comes over the pass. Bring {count} × {item} before the snow shuts the road.
offer: Nothing grows up here but stone and wind, and the fire must never go out: a man frozen on the saddle walks toward its smoke. Could you bring us {count} × {item}?
progress: The woodshed is half empty, and the clouds are low.
complete: God bless you. That will keep the fire through the worst of it.
